e: The Supreme Court of the United Kingdom rejects Bahrain's attempt to use state immunity to block a spyware lawsuit brought by two dissidents.
The United States imposes a 12.5% tariff on Bahrain, citing the presence of alleged forced labour in the supply chain.
One person is injured in Iranian drone attacks on Hamad Town and Manama.
An officer of the National Security Agency is sentenced to life imprisonment over the death of a detainee arrested for expressing support for Iran during the ongoing war.
The state-owned energy company Bapco Energies reports an Iranian drone attack on one of its storage facilities, causing an oil tank to catch fire.
Iran conducts strikes on Amazon Web Services servers in Bahrain.
Bahrain imposes a nighttime maritime curfew from 6:00 pm to 4:00 am to restrict sea traffic and strengthen coastal security following reported attacks attributed to Iran.
The smelter facility of Aluminium Bahrain in Askar, Southern Governorate, is targeted by Iranian attacks.
An Iranian strike hits fuel storage tanks at a facility in Muharraq Governorate.
An Iranian drone damages a desalination plant. Falling missile debris injures three people and damages a university building in Manama.

An explosion near Manama causes a fire near a petroleum refinery and injures at least 32 Bahraini citizens, four of them seriously. An analysis by academic researchers examined by Reuters finds that an American-operated Patriot missile was likely involved in the blast after it downed an Iranian drone mid-air.
Iran carries out a drone attack on the Financial Harbour Towers commercial complex in Manama housing the Israeli embassy.
The Bahrain Defence Force reports that 74 Iranian missiles and 117 hostile drones haven been intercepted and destroyed in the last hours.
An Iranian drone strikes the Crowne Plaza Hotel in Manama, which houses US embassy personnel. No casualties are reported.
In retaliation for the 2026 Israeli–United States strikes on Iran, Iran launches ballistic missiles at a United States Navy facility in Bahrain, targeting the headquarters of the U.S. Fifth Fleet.
Iranian drones strike residential areas of Manama, including a direct hit on a 20-storey tower block.
Political activist Ibrahim Sharif is sentenced to six months' imprisonment for criticizing Arab states and calling for more support for Palestine in an interview.
Bahrain assumes a two-year non-permanent seat at the United Nations Security Council.
